name: Ove
title: Drill Serjeant of the Northguard
examine: Pinewatch-born, Crown-sworn, and the only man in the fort the town will take a correction from. Counts the weapon rack before he counts the men, and has never once found the rack wrong.
lines: I stood my nights on the tower before I ever wore the weld. The rota made me. The Crown just pays me.
Shoulders back. No, not you. Him. Always him.
The town thinks we are guests. The captain thinks we are hosts. I think the wall does not care.
